title: 第1章 杂役院的废物第2章 一万次挥剑
content_zh:
雨是从后半夜开始下的。
天还没亮透，杂役院西侧那间最破的茅草屋里，顾渊已经睁开了眼睛。
他今年十六岁，入苍穹剑宗整整四年。
四年里，他每一天都是这个时辰醒来——比鸡早，比狗勤，比杂役院门口那棵老槐树上的鸦雀还要准时。
顾渊坐起身，稻草铺就的床板发出不堪重负的吱呀声。
他低头看了眼自己的双手，掌心布满老茧，指节粗大变形，虎口处裂着几道新旧交叠的口子。
这不像十六岁少年的手，倒像是个在矿洞里挖了四十年煤的老矿工。
淬体境一层。
四年。
一千四百六十天。
他连第二层都摸不到。
“杂灵根。“
顾渊在心里默念了一遍这三个字，语气平淡得像在说别人的事。
苍穹剑宗收弟子，首重灵根。
天灵根百年难遇，地灵根已是万中无一，普通灵根够得上外门门槛，杂灵根……杂灵根就是用来扫地的、挑水的、烧火的、洗厕所的。
杂役院，专收杂灵根。
顾渊穿好那身洗得发白的粗布弟子服，系紧草鞋上的麻绳，从床底摸出一柄剑。
那是一柄再普通不过的铁剑，剑鞘斑驳，剑柄缠着的布条已经磨出了毛边。
这是他的养父留给他的唯一遗物——据说曾是某个剑修的佩剑，但顾渊怎么看都觉得它更像是一柄砍柴的钝刀。
可这就是他的剑。

四年来，他每一天都握着它。
顾渊将剑系在腰间，推开门。
清晨的寒气夹着雨丝扑面而来，他缩了缩脖子，拎着墙角的木桶向山下走去。
这是他的活计——挑水。
杂役院三十七口人，一天八缸水，一缸不能少。
山道泥泞，顾渊深一脚浅一脚地往下走。
雨水顺着他的衣领渗进去，冰凉的触感让他打了个寒颤，但他脸上没什么表情，只是将木桶换了个肩膀，继续走。
“哟，这不是咱们杂役院的'天才'吗？“
声音从头顶传来。
顾渊脚步一顿，没有抬头。
他认得这个声音——赵玄龙，内门弟子，元丹境，赵家嫡系，十八岁，天赋上佳，背景深厚，脾性……
跋扈。
山道上跳下来三个人，为首的那个一袭月白锦袍，腰间悬着一柄镶玉长剑，剑穗上的明珠在雨幕中泛着温润的光。
他生得俊朗，剑眉星目，只是嘴角挂着的那抹笑，让人不太舒服。
赵玄龙上下打量了顾渊一眼，目光在他腰间的铁剑上停了停，笑意更浓了。
“我听说你每天都带着这柄破剑到处晃悠？“赵玄龙上前一步，靴尖挑起顾渊的下巴。
“怎么，一个杂灵根的废物，还想学人家做剑修？“
顾渊没有动。
他不是不想躲，是躲不掉。
赵玄龙元丹境的威压笼罩下来，他连一根手指都抬不起来。

淬体境一层对上元丹境，就像蚂蚁面对大象——不，连蚂蚁都算不上，顶多算蚂蚁脚边的一粒尘土。
“问你话呢。“赵玄龙的靴尖用了点力，顾渊的脑袋被迫仰起一个屈辱的角度。
“哑巴了？“
顾渊的嘴唇动了动：“……灵根不好，与剑无关。“
他的声音很低，沙哑，像是很久没有好好说过话，但每一个字都咬得很清楚。
content_en:
It started to rain in the second half of the night.
It was still dark, but Gu Yuan had already opened his eyes in the shabbiest thatched hut on the west side of the courtyard.
He is sixteen years old this year and has been in the Cang Qiong Sword Sect for four full years.
For four years, he woke up at this hour every day - earlier than chickens, more diligent than dogs, and more punctual than the crows on the old locust tree at the entrance of the yard.
Gu Yuan sat up, and the bed made of straw made an overwhelming squeaking sound.
He looked down at his hands. His palms were covered with calluses, his knuckles were thick and deformed, and there were several old and new gashes in the tiger's mouth.
They don't look like the hands of a sixteen-year-old boy, but rather like the hands of an old miner who has been digging coal in the mine for forty years.
The first level of body tempering realm.
Four years.
One thousand four hundred and sixty days.
He couldn't even touch the second layer.
"Miscellaneous spiritual roots."
Gu Yuan recited these three words silently in his mind, his tone as calm as if he was talking about someone else's business.
When Cang Qiong Sword Sect accepts disciples, spiritual roots are the first priority.
Heavenly spiritual roots are rare to find in a hundred years, and earthly spiritual roots are rare. Ordinary spiritual roots can reach the threshold of the outer door. Miscellaneous spiritual roots... Miscellaneous spiritual roots are used to sweep the floor, carry water, light fires, and wash toilets.
The Miscellaneous Service Courtyard specializes in collecting miscellaneous spiritual roots.
Gu Yuan put on his washed-white coarse cloth disciple uniform, tightened the hemp rope on his straw sandals, and took out a sword from under the bed.
It was an ordinary iron sword. The scabbard was mottled, and the cloth strip wrapped around the hilt had worn edges.
This is the only relic left to him by his adoptive father - it is said that it was once the sword of a certain swordsman, but no matter how Gu Yuan looked at it, he felt that it was more like a dull knife for chopping wood.
But this is his sword.
He held it every day for four years.
Gu Yuan tied the sword around his waist and opened the door.
The early morning chill hit his face along with the raindrops. He shrank his neck and walked down the mountain carrying the barrel in the corner.
This is his job - carrying water.
There are thirty-seven people in the handyman's courtyard, and they need eight tanks of water a day, and one tank cannot be left behind.
The mountain road was muddy, so Gu Yuan walked down one step at a time.
Rain seeped into his collar, and the cold touch made him shiver, but there was no expression on his face. He just changed the bucket to his shoulder and continued walking.
"Hey, isn't this the 'genius' of our courtyard?"
The sound came from above.
Gu Yuan paused and did not raise his head.
He recognized this voice - Zhao Xuanlong, inner disciple, Yuan Dan realm, direct descendant of the Zhao family, eighteen years old, with excellent talent, profound background, temperament...
Domineering.
Three people jumped down from the mountain road. The leader was wearing a moon-white brocade robe, with a jade-inlaid long sword hanging on his waist. The pearl on the sword's tassel glowed warmly in the rain.
He was handsome, with sharp eyebrows and starry eyes, but the smile hanging on the corner of his mouth made people uncomfortable.
Zhao Xuanlong looked Gu Yuan up and down, his eyes paused on the iron sword at his waist, and his smile grew stronger.
"I heard that you carry this broken sword around every day?" Zhao Xuanlong took a step forward and lifted Gu Yuan's chin with the toe of his boot.
"Why, a loser with mixed spiritual roots still wants to learn how to practice swordsmanship?"
Gu Yuan didn't move.
It's not that he doesn't want to hide, he just can't.
The coercion of Zhao Xuanlong's Yuan Dan realm shrouded him, and he couldn't even lift a finger.
The first level of the Body Tempering Realm facing the Yuan Dan Realm is like an ant facing an elephant - no, not even an ant, at most a grain of dust at the ant's feet.
"I'm asking you a question." Zhao Xuanlong exerted some force on the tip of his boot, and Gu Yuan's head was forced to raise at a humiliating angle.
"Mute?"
Gu Yuan's lips moved: "...the spiritual root is not good, it has nothing to do with the sword."
His voice was low and hoarse, as if he hadn't spoken properly for a long time, but every word was pronounced clearly.
